# Serial test frames - hex mode, 115200 8N1. Paste lines as-is into SSCOM/Realterm (generated by export3.py; length byte checked by script).
# Text writes end with FF FF when shorter than the variable; Text Display must have end marker 0xFFFF enabled.
# Icon / bar writes: 2-byte value. Page switch: 5A A5 07 82 00 84 5A 01 00 <page>.
